unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: Re:TH/022TH: [Counter] 【Act】 [An/Turn] "Exceed Star" During either players' attack phase, look at the top five cards of your deck, and call up to one monster from among them by paying its [Call Cost]. That card becomes a size 0 until it leaves the field.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Inspects top 5 cards, calls a monster by paying Call Cost, and dynamically alters that monster's size attribute to 0 until it leaves the field.
information_needed: Approved schema for dynamic size alteration on called monsters lasting until leave-field.

en.plain:
